HomePage.title: PairSight
HomePage.tagline: A second look at every match.
HomePage.description: Compare entity-resolution vendors on your own customer records. PairSight asks Jev to judge each candidate pair, then shows where each vendor agrees or disagrees.
HomePage.stepUpload: Upload your records and each vendor’s matches
HomePage.stepRules: Choose which pairs are worth checking
HomePage.stepCompare: See where vendors and PairSight disagree

Auth.signInDescription: Your evaluations are saved to your account.
Auth.signUpDescription: Save evaluations and come back to them later.
Auth.invalidInput: Enter a valid email and a password of at least {min} characters.
Auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.

Evaluations.title: Evaluations
Evaluations.description: Each evaluation compares one set of source records against one or more vendors’ matches.
Evaluations.emptyDescription: Create one to upload your records and a vendor’s matches.
Evaluations.runSummary: Run {number} · {pairs, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}}

Records.title: Source records
Records.description: Upload the CSV every vendor evaluated. Each row needs a unique record reference.
Records.replaceWarning: Replacing the source file starts a new dataset. Vendor results must be uploaded again, and earlier runs keep their original records.
Records.dropHint: CSV with a header row · up to 500 records · 1 MB
Records.previewDescription: Pick the column that uniquely identifies each record, then tell PairSight what each column contains. Suggestions come from the column names — check them.
Records.saved: Saved {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}.
Records.missingReferences: {count, plural, one {# row has} other {# rows have}} no record reference: {rows}
Records.duplicateRoles: Each role can be mapped to one column only. Used more than once: {roles}

CsvErrors.empty: The file has no data rows under the header.
CsvErrors.too_many_rows: The file has {found} rows; the limit is {limit}.
CsvErrors.too_many_columns: The file has {found} columns; the limit is {limit}.
CsvErrors.duplicate_header: More than one column is named: {headers}
CsvErrors.ragged_rows: These rows have a different number of cells than the header: {rows}
CsvErrors.too_large: The file is larger than 1 MB.

Vendors.title: Vendor results
Vendors.description: Upload each vendor’s export of the pairs it matched. Vendor names, scores and decisions are never sent to Jev.
Vendors.added: {count, plural, one {# matched pair} other {# matched pairs}}
Vendors.fileHint: One matched pair per row, two record-reference columns
Vendors.completeTitle: Is this the vendor’s complete list of matches?
Vendors.completeExplanation: PairSight treats any pair missing from this file as “not matched” by the vendor. That’s only fair if the export lists every match the vendor made on these same records.
Vendors.completeConfirm: Yes, this export lists every match this vendor made
Vendors.savedSummary: Added {pairs, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}}. {skipped}
Vendors.skipped: {self, plural, =0 {} one {# self-pair skipped.} other {# self-pairs skipped.}} {duplicates, plural, =0 {} one {# repeated row collapsed.} other {# repeated rows collapsed.}}
Vendors.unknownReferences: {count, plural, one {# reference isn’t} other {# references aren’t}} in the source records
Vendors.missingReferenceRows: {count, plural, one {# row is} other {# rows are}} missing a reference: {rows}
Vendors.maxVendors: You can compare up to {max} vendors.
Vendors.errorsTitle: Fix these before adding this vendor

Rules.title: Identity and blocking
Rules.description: Define what counts as the same person, then choose which pairs are worth asking Jev about.
Rules.identityTitle: What counts as the same individual
Rules.countryHint: Two-letter code, used to read local phone numbers
Rules.jevFieldsDescription: Only these mapped fields are sent, together with your definition above.
Rules.blockingDescription: Records that share a value under any rule become candidate pairs. Rules overlap, and blocking never decides a match — Jev does.
Rules.ruleEmailHint: Trimmed and lowercased; dots and +tags kept
Rules.rulePhoneHint: Converted to international format using the country
Rules.ruleNameHint: Case, spacing and full vs. first + last name normalized
Rules.stats: {buckets, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} · {pairs, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}} · largest {largest}
Rules.bucketWarning: A group of {size, number} records creates {pairs, number} pairs. This only affects workload, not accuracy.
Rules.countryUnsaved: Unsaved change: the counts below still read phone numbers as {country}. Save to recount them with the new country.
Rules.ruleOverCap: This rule alone creates {pairs, number} pairs; one run allows {limit, number}.
Rules.customHint: Custom rule: every field must match
Rules.customDescription: Pick up to three fields. Records become a candidate pair only when all of them match after normalization.
Rules.customDuplicate: A rule with these fields already exists.
Rules.customLimit: You can add up to {max} custom rules.

Plan.title: Review the plan
Plan.description: This is exactly what the run will evaluate. Nothing is sent to Jev until you start.
Plan.addedByVendor: Added only because a vendor matched them
Plan.reusable: Already judged in an earlier run (reused)
Plan.jevReceives: For each pair: {fields}, your definition of the same individual, and the country. No vendor names, scores or decisions, and no record references.
Plan.cost: Estimated cost: about {cost} (at a stand-in rate until TypeSafe publishes its own price).
Plan.fictionalOnly: Use fictional or anonymized records only for now.
Plan.no_vendors: Add at least one vendor’s results.
Plan.no_jev_fields: Choose at least one field for Jev to compare.
Plan.no_pairs: There are no pairs to evaluate. Turn on a blocking rule or add vendor results.
Plan.too_many_pairs: This plan has {count} pairs; one run allows {limit}.
Plan.causeVendors: Added only because a vendor matched them: {pairs} pairs
Plan.causesNote: Rules overlap, so these can add up to more than the total.
Plan.fixRules: Turn off or narrow a rule

Run.title: Run {number}
Run.description: Jev is judging each pair. Results appear as soon as it finishes.
Run.keepOpen: Keep this page open — the run pauses if you leave and resumes when you come back.
Run.completeWithFailures: Run complete. {count, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}} failed and {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} shown as incomplete — not as “no match”.
Run.missing_key: TypeSafe’s API key isn’t configured. Add TYPESAFE_API_KEY to .env.local, restart the server, then resume.
Run.invalid_key: TypeSafe rejected the API key. Check TYPESAFE_API_KEY in .env.local, restart the server, then resume.
Run.errorUnknown: The run couldn’t continue. Try again in a moment.

Categories.both_matchedMeaning: Vendor and PairSight agree it’s a match
Categories.pairsight_onlyMeaning: A possible duplicate the vendor missed
Categories.vendor_onlyMeaning: A possible wrong vendor match — or a PairSight mistake
Categories.incompleteMeaning: Not judged yet, or the evaluation failed

Results.title: Results
Results.agreementNote: Categories show agreement between the vendor and PairSight, not proven correctness.
Results.coverage: {total, plural, one {# pair} other {# pairs}} compared — {fromRules} from your rules, {addedByVendor} added only because a vendor matched them. Pairs outside your rules that no vendor matched weren’t evaluated, so missed duplicates among them can’t be seen.
Results.incompleteBanner: {count, plural, one {# pair isn’t} other {# pairs aren’t}} judged yet or failed. They’re excluded from the four categories.
Results.thresholdHelp: Pairs Jev scores at or above this count as a PairSight match. Changing it re-decides from saved scores — Jev isn’t called again.

Pair.aiNote: AI judgment — it can be wrong.
Pair.pendingJudgment: Jev hasn’t judged this pair yet.
Pair.failedJudgment: Jev couldn’t judge this pair ({reason}). It’s excluded from the categories.
Pair.originVendor: Added because {vendors} matched it (outside your rules)
Pair.keyboardHint: <key>J</key> <key>K</key> next and previous · <key>Esc</key> back to results

Unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
Unsaved.description: Your changes to the identity definition, Jev fields or blocking rules haven’t been saved. If you leave now, they’ll be lost.
